train is split into 256 plain tar shards (5,000 pkls each) purely so it
transfers as ~256 files instead of 1.28M tiny ones. Each shard is an ordinary
tarball — extract it with stdlib tarfile or tar xf, no special library.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/kevinywu/1m-hugs.
